actual_checks: Full exact report, literal prompt, provenance/source records and both full retained prior scientific bodies read. The new unconditional level-density theorem and normalized cuspidal trace consequence differ from the earlier fixed-quotient conditional signed-orbit filter.

Humphries Theorem 1.5 is specialized to empty P, mu_0=1 and trivial character. Exact exponents are 1-4 alpha for Gamma_0, 1-3 alpha for Gamma_1, and 1-(8/3) alpha for Gamma(q), with arbitrary epsilon loss. The two character correction factors equal one for the principal character.

The author correctly uses lambda=1/4+t^2 and it in (0,1/2), so t=-i nu, avoiding a sign error. Alpha is fixed in (0,1/2), with strict exceptional cutoff. Taking epsilon<c alpha gives sublinear exceptional counts divided by volume; multiplying the count by a bounded test function proves the stated normalized cuspidal trace bound.

Positive count exponents remain compatible with a single exception at every level. No uniform spectral exclusion, all-alpha limit, constant eigenfunction or residual-spectrum statement is inferred. Full Selberg 1/4 remains open within this report.
